name.value: The Root Cellar Village Green Grocer

description.value: The Root Cellar Village Green Grocer is a beloved Victoria institution specializing in farm-fresh, locally grown BC produce at affordable prices, with a full-service butcher (The Chop Shop), deli, bulk grocery, and a coffee bar. This is the Cook Street Village location, one of two Root Cellar stores in the greater Victoria area. Touring cyclists resupplying in the Cook Street neighbourhood will find a wide range of fresh and packaged food options in a walkable, bike-friendly urban village.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: staple (4 spaces) at 6m; rack (6 spaces) at 20m; staple (4 spaces) at 33m; rack at 62m. Total: 14 spaces.

The site describes a full-service grocer with produce, deli, butcher, bulk, and coffee departments, but contains no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling infrastructure. OSM wheelchair=yes is noted but not independently confirmed via website.
concerns: Website lists a general contact phone of (250) 477-9495 (McKenzie Corner location); the Cook Street / Oxford Corner location phone (778) 265-8166 matches OSM but is secondary in site navigation — verify this remains the correct number for this location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established full-service grocery store in a cycling-friendly urban neighbourhood; a clear resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through Victoria's Cook Street Village.
